name: Indonesia Comic Con
blurb: Indonesia's largest pop-culture event in Jakarta, covering comics, toys, movies and games with celebrity guests, cosplayers and comic artists.
notes: The only announced edition is the 10th ICC, confirmed by both the homepage text ('10th edition 3-4 OCTOBER 2026 JIEXPO Kemayoran') and JSON-LD (2026-10-03 to 2026-10-04 at JIEXPO Kemayoran), with a full guest lineup already live (Mackenyu plus international cosplayers, a singer and about 25 comic artists). That edition ended 2026-10-04, one day before this research window opens (2026-10-05), so per the brief's 'only list upcoming editions' rule it is excluded rather than listed as upcoming. No 11th-edition date has been announced on the site yet as of 2026-10-05, so editions is empty for now; this is worth re-checking soon since ICC typically announces close to its own date. Organizer name is carried over from the assignment brief (PT Ekspresi Generasi Kreatif); the homepage text sample is dominated by the long guest list and gets cut off before any footer/legal-entity line, so this was not independently re-confirmed on site within budget.
